infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Aura uses your microphone exclusively for ephemeral on-device voice offloading. Audio is never recorded, stored, or transmitted over any network.
infoPlist.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Aura uses speech recognition locally on your device to transcribe spoken thoughts into text before immediate vaporization into embers.
infoPlist.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: Aura uses Face ID to securely authenticate and decrypt your zero-knowledge private time-locked thoughts.

plugins.faceIDPermission: Allow Aura to use Face ID to decrypt your private thoughts.
